antq_m10_final_radagaisus_rhine = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	content_trigger = {
		tag = XAA
	}
	can_start = {
		current_date >= 405.1.1
		current_date < 407.1.1
		country_exists = c:XAA
	}
	can_end = {
		OR = {
			current_date >= 407.1.1
			var:antq_m10_final_radagaisus_rhine_resolution_progress >= 100
		}
	}
	tooltip = {
		custom_tooltip = "antq_m10_final_radagaisus_rhine_tooltip"
	}
	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { owner ?= c:XAA }
			value = owner.country_color
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "antq_m10_final_radagaisus_rhine_legend"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}
	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = antq_m10_final_radagaisus_rhine_resolution_progress value = 0 }
		c:XAA = { trigger_event_non_silently = antq_m10_final.5000 }
	}
	on_monthly = {
		c:XAA = {
			if = {
				limit = { stability >= 20 at_war = no }
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_final_radagaisus_rhine_resolution_progress add = 3 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { stability >= 0 at_war = yes }
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_final_radagaisus_rhine_resolution_progress add = 1.5 } }
			}
			else = {
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_final_radagaisus_rhine_resolution_progress add = 0.5 } }
			}
			random_list = {
				1 = {
					add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -0.5 }
					add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -0.25 }
					capital = { province = { change_province_food_percentage = -0.01 } }
				}
				23 = {}
			}
		}
	}
	on_ended = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_final_radagaisus_rhine_resolution_progress } remove_variable = antq_m10_final_radagaisus_rhine_resolution_progress }
		c:XAA ?= { add_stability = stability_weak_bonus }
	}
}
